title: A binary heap
hints: With `Less` as the order, "parent must not be greater than child" is `!less_(child, parent)`. Sift up while `less_(a_[i], a_[parent])`; sift down by swapping with the child for which `less_` says it is smallest.
`std::tuple` compares element by element, so a heap of `(value, list, position)` tuples orders by value first, exactly as the merge needs.
